subject: Re: Status: MNIST suite reproduced, Omniglot risk
body:
Team,

Decision from yesterday's review: we're cutting the full Omniglot ablation grid from this phase. Csilla's May 15 runs already show the gumbel_matrix router beating shared_bottom on validation accuracy, and that's enough evidence for the design review. The remaining grid moves to a Q3 stretch goal.

What stays committed:
- May 29 design review for the routing library goes ahead. Jorge's June refactor allocation is unchanged and is the critical path to a usable component.
- Quentin writes up the logdir-hygiene tooling as part of the library so no downstream team repeats our 4-day loss.

I'll frame the OKR submission around "one backbone, learned sharing, budget knob" — the budget_penalty result is the demo. Deshawn, please sanity-check headcount lines before I submit.

Priya
